card.name: Second digit after a leading 1
card.fires_on: The digit 0 or 1 right after a leading 1 inside a number, often in rates like mg/10 mL or in chemical names. Also fires on some middle pieces of unusual brand or personal names.

modes.label: Digit after 1
modes.description: A 0 or 1 following a leading 1 in a number or a ratio such as mg/10 mL.

modes.label: Inside odd names
modes.description: A middle piece of a coined drug name or a personal name.
